semiconductor_relevance: High — OSA Inc. provides critical wafer heating plates used in semiconductor manufacturing processes like CVD and PVD.
summary: OSA Inc., through its Chuangtai Technology division, manufactures high-precision wafer heating plates essential for semiconductor processes such as Chemical Vapor Deposition (CVD) and Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD). The company offers both standard and customized heating solutions, focusing on stable performance and timely delivery to meet the semiconductor industry's stringent requirements.
capabilities: Wafer heating plates for CVD applications
Wafer heating plates for PVD applications
